description: One Sandooq page as Markdown — the same representation the site serves at /agent and via Accept: text/markdown, with no HTML or navigation chrome.

locale.description: Response language: 'en' (default) or 'ar'. Arabic returns the Arabic copy the site publishes, not a translation of the English.

path.description: Site-relative path, no leading slash and no language prefix — e.g. 'pricing', 'about', 'pos-system/saudi-arabia', 'blog/<slug>'. Use '' for the home page. Choose the language with `locale`, not with a '/ar' prefix.
